name: wallstimator
description: Wallstimator web shell: capture page + geometry-core WASM build.

scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build crates/geometry-core --release --target web --out-dir ../../web/pkg --no-pack && wasm-opt -Os --enable-bulk-memory --enable-nontrapping-float-to-int web/pkg/geometry_core_bg.wasm -o web/pkg/geometry_core_bg.wasm
